Name: Unlock Dye Menu
Author: Shaklin
Description:
[center][b]UNLOCK DYE MENU[/b]

This mod is for players who have a lot of dyeable clothing mods.
It makes dyeing easier and it is just faster.[/center]

[u]How it works[/u]:

You must have unlocked the sewing machine event (with Emily) first.
Then you can just hit [i][b]enter [/b][/i]in the [i]dye menu[/i] and it will be activated.
This has to be done with each new coloring.


[u]Change Config:[/u]
Start the game 1x, then it creates a [b]config.json[/b].
Open it with Editor/Notepad.

[b]Instantly_DyeMenu[/b]
Standard is on [i]false[/i], so its not breaking the gameplay, because you can still use items if you want.
[quote][code]"Instantly_DyeMenu": "[b]false[/b]",[/code][/quote]
With [i]true [/i]you dont need to hit Enter. If you click on the color pots, you are instantly in the dye menu.
[quote][code]"Instantly_DyeMenu": "[b]true[/b]",[/code][/quote]

[b]Unlocked_DyeMenu[/b]
If 'Instantly_DyeMenu' on [i]false[/i], you have to hit first a key to activate the dye menu.
Standard is on [i]Enter[/i]
[quote][code]﻿"Unlocked_DyeMenu": "Enter"[/code][/quote]
You can change the Key, for example to:
[quote][code]"Unlocked_DyeMenu": "Space"
[/code][/quote]Now you can use spacebar, instead of enter.


more help with Key-bindings here:
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Keyboard]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Keyboard[/url]
